code:
def test_bell_state_construction():
  state = apply_gates([kron_gate(H,I), CNOT],
                       zero_state(2))
  assert np.allclose(state,
    [1/np.sqrt(2), 0, 0, 1/np.sqrt(2)])

def test_bell_state_probabilities():
  probs = probabilities(state)
  assert np.allclose(probs, [0.5, 0, 0, 0.5])
caption: Each test checks an independently-verifiable fact, not a vague "looks right."
